title: The Snake in the Trap & 'A' or 'An'
subject: English Language
objectives: Read and understand a story about friendship

blocks.alt: Two friends standing near a trap
blocks.caption: Okon called his friend Akan to help him.

blocks.md:
Once upon a time Okon, a farmer, went to check his traps. As he went near one of the traps, he noticed something caught in the trap which he could not see clearly. He called his friend, Akan, to help him remove the catch from the trap. Akan realised that the animal in the trap was a large snake which had gone to hide behind the stem of the trap.

'It is a large snake and this type spits!' Akan shouted.

'Hold it by the tail,' Okon answered.

'The trap caught it by the tail!' Akan replied.

'Then catch it by the head,' replied Okon.

'Do you want it to bite me?' Akan asked.

'This snake does not bite, it only spits into people's eyes,' answered Okon.

'Oh, ho! You want me to be blind?' Akan answered. 'It is your trap. So go ahead and take your catch.'

'I know now that you are not a good friend,' Okon said.

'You are a true friend who wants me to be hurt,' Akan replied.

The two men stood there looking at the large beast until it struggled out of the trap and crawled away into the jungle.

Use **'an'** when the next word starts with a vowel sound (A, E, I, O, U). Use **'a'** for all other letters.

- **A** pen
- **A** car
- **An** egg
- **An** ink bottle

quiz.q: What job does Okon do in the story?
quiz.explain: The story says Okon is a farmer.

quiz.q: What was caught in the trap?
quiz.explain: Akan saw it was a large snake.
We say 'an aeroplane' because 'a' is a vowel.
